prompts.prompt:
Create a high fidelity IOS NATIVE APP design proposal, not a website in an iPhone frame. App: Weavelet Canvas. Use unmistakable modern Apple iOS/iPadOS native design: LIGHT MODE, system white/secondary grouped backgrounds, black SF-like Japanese typography, system blue tint, SF Symbols stroke icons, native navigation bars, navigation title hierarchy, native menu buttons, bottom safe area/home indicator. NO dark web slate, NO repeated nested bordered panels, NO desktop HTML buttons, NO marketing slogans. Compact useful vertical rhythm, modest consistent margins, icons fully inset and centered in their controls, no clipping or hanging avatars. Avoid giant whitespace between message header, content and actions. Keep source app semantic locations: sidebar/upper navigation/main content/bottom composer; message role at leading header and TWO distinct trailing control groups: display selection '原文 ⌄' and a group of evaluation badge button, slashed-eye toggle, shield toggle. Render these groups as native subtle control groupings; independent toggles must not look like mutually exclusive segmented options. Avatar is a small generic assistant SF spark icon, not giant vendor logo. Preserve controls but redesign visual treatment natively. Japanese labels concise, no invented font controls. Show layouts as flat pixel-perfect design mockups, not photography. The supplied reference is ONLY a semantic layout reference; deliberately replace its web appearance with native iOS design. All icons and text must be contained within respective app safe margins.
Landscape design board title '01 iOS 全体構成'. Left: iPadOS native app landscape occupying 70%, right iPhone native app 25%. Tablet native sidebar labeled '会話', search field, list of three conversations, native bottom entries sync/settings/import-export. Main native navigation bar, inline model menu, upper trailing chat/branch view selection and layout menu. Under toolbar chat pane next to branching canvas, 4 simple connected tree nodes with no merges, small native undo/fit controls bottom inset, all contained. Chat content is compact rows, not oversized cards; assistant role header with two native control groups inside its own message row, body below, 3 small footer actions. iPhone top nav '設計の相談' with leading sidebar icon/trailing view menu, user message then assistant message with header controls wrap to second row only if needed, bottom native composer. Crop to content and useful app viewport. No tall blank bands. Show visible system status bar and safe area on phone. Header title modest.

edits: Keep this native iOS light-mode design exactly, only correct semantic controls: replace thumbs-up/down under assistant replies with regenerate circular arrow, copy, edit pencil. No thumbs anywhere. Top iPad model selector text must be 'モデル' not 'アシスタント'. Group the three assistant header status icons inside ONE softly filled pill next to the separate '原文' menu, no three separate pill backgrounds. Preserve compact spacing and all other layout.

Keep this native iOS chat design exactly. Replace microphone button at right of BOTH app composer bars with blue send up-arrow. Keep system keyboard dictation microphone untouched. Do not add voice functionality to app. All other spacing and content unchanged.

RECOMPOSE as compact cropped iOS MESSAGE COMPONENT examples, NOT full device screens. Remove all phone hardware frames, status/nav bars, bottom composers, and keyboard. Three side-by-side content-hugging panels labelled 通常幅, 狭幅, 編集中, with 16px margins. Each panel contains only assistant header, message text, footer. No blank area below footer. Light native iOS appearance unchanged. Normal panel header has small avatar/role and two native groups. Edited panel native text editor with caret and exactly two text lines, NO character count, directly below Cancel/Save/Generate text controls. Crop image to short landscape aspect ratio around 2.5:1, no unused white regions or empty vertical strips. Keep title 03 iOS バブルと操作, no extra slogan.
finalCorrection: Change ONLY the upper three-icon capsule beside '原文' in BOTH the tablet assistant message header and phone assistant message header. Those upper capsules must contain exactly: a checkmark rosette badge, an eye with diagonal slash, an outline shield, from left to right. They are evaluation/omit/protect, NOT regenerate/copy/edit. Keep the LOWER footer controls (circular arrow, copy, pencil) unchanged. Keep every other element, text, color, dimension, spacing, layout unchanged. No other edits.
